description: Introduction — welcome, battlefield grid, and the three Progeny.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Introduction Commander, welcome to Tactica: a Space Opera.Your goal is to conquer this frontier sector for its BISMUTH.Build an army, defend your structures, and conquer the sector.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Battlefield The battle is fought on a grid of squares. Positioning, terrain, and reach all matter.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Choose your Progeny Three PROGENY fight for control of the BISMUTH:◦ Ertrians — mine it for trade ◦ Virix — grow from it ◦ Sentus — draw power from itEach faction has its own production rules and bonuses.You will learn universal tactics first, then faction specifics.
